name: HighLevel Services
tagline: Your HighLevel department, run entirely under your brand.
description: From onboarding new clients to day-to-day administration and custom development, growX runs the HighLevel work your agency sells, 100% white-label. We live inside the platform every day, so setups are clean, requests are fast, and your client never knows another team is behind it.

deliverables.title: Client onboarding, done for you
deliverables.description: We take a new client from an empty sub-account to a fully configured, on-brand system: dashboard, calendars, channels, deliverability, data migration, and core automations, plus a guided walkthrough.

deliverables.title: White-labeled dashboards
deliverables.description: Every dashboard, domain, and login carries your logo, so the platform feels like it came from your in-house team.

deliverables.title: Verified email and SMS sending
deliverables.description: Deliverability set up properly, so campaigns land in the inbox instead of spam.

deliverables.title: Ongoing admin support
deliverables.description: Workflow builds and fixes, calendar and pipeline upkeep, list hygiene, and support tickets handled on a predictable SLA.

deliverables.title: Automation and campaign builds
deliverables.description: Reliable workflows and campaigns built and maintained, so the account keeps working after launch.

deliverables.title: Custom development and integrations
deliverables.description: When off-the-shelf HighLevel hits a wall, our developers wire up custom API integrations, advanced automations, and third-party connections.

deliverables.title: Reusable snapshot builds
deliverables.description: Snapshots you can deploy across clients, so your best setup becomes repeatable instead of rebuilt each time.

deliverables.title: Monthly account health reports
deliverables.description: Clear, white-label reporting on each account, so you always know what is running and what needs attention.

whyUs.title: HighLevel is our home turf
whyUs.description: A team that builds sub-accounts every day catches the deliverability and automation gaps that trip up generalists.

whyUs.title: Predictable SLAs on every request
whyUs.description: Each ticket is triaged and resolved within a fixed window you can confidently promise your clients.

whyUs.title: Invisible under your brand
whyUs.description: Every login, reply, report, and integration carries your name. Your client never knows growX is behind it.

faq.question: Do you work inside our HighLevel account?
faq.answer: Yes. We work as a user inside your agency's HighLevel, on the client sub-accounts you assign, entirely under your brand.

faq.question: Can you cover both setup and ongoing work?
faq.answer: Yes. Order onboarding as a one-off to launch a client, then add monthly admin support to keep the account healthy, or take on custom development when you need to build past the platform's defaults.

faq.question: Will our clients know it is outsourced?
faq.answer: No. Every dashboard, email, reply, and handoff is white-label. The work reads as your in-house team throughout.

faq.question: How fast are support requests handled?
faq.answer: Admin requests are triaged and resolved within a fixed SLA window, which is faster on the paid partnership tiers, so you can make real promises to your clients.

faq.question: How is it priced?
faq.answer: Onboarding and custom builds are fixed-price per project; ongoing admin is a monthly retainer. Everything is ordered in one click from the partner portal.

faqExtra.question: What counts as one account?
faqExtra.answer: One client subaccount under active management — its onboarding upkeep, admin queue, and health reporting. Agency-level work that benefits all accounts (snapshots, templates) is spread across them, not billed twice.

faqExtra.question: Do we keep our own HighLevel agency plan?
faqExtra.answer: Yes — that's the point. You keep your agency account, your subaccounts, and your SaaS subscription margin. We work inside what you own; nothing about your HighLevel economics changes.

faqExtra.question: Can you rescue a messy existing account?
faqExtra.answer: Yes. We start with an account audit — configuration, sending, automations, unused features — delivered as a white-label report. Then we clean up and rebuild only what the audit justifies.

faqExtra.question: Do you handle A2P and compliance registration?
faqExtra.answer: Yes — carrier compliance registration for SMS and proper domain verification for email are part of the sending setup, not an extra. It's the difference between messages that land and campaigns that quietly fail.
